items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'a fellow by the name of Louis Capit' as playing in Chris's band. The interviewee does not claim to have met, played with, or known him personally, only acknowledging the name in the context of the band roster.

ctx.x: And, and would, who was playing with Chris's band at that time?
Um, a fellow by the name of Louis Capit. Yes, guitar. Uh-huh. And another fellow by the name of Faisal.
Yeah. I know him. Eddie, Eddie Woods was his real name. Yeah.
